accessibility_insights.reason: The frozen generated project did not build, so no target runtime was available for Accessibility Insights verification.

evidence.detail: The controlled pinned build selected .NET SDK 9.0.313; dotnet build exited 1 because the WinUI XamlCompiler exited with code 1.
The installed WinUI 2.0.12 XML metadata contains zero exact matches for Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.Symbol.Devices, while the frozen XAML uses SymbolIcon Symbol=Devices.
Controller recorded the frozen eight-file project hashes after the failed build; no generated source repair was performed.
